newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Saha Airlines locates two freighters to Maastricht.
newsitem.headline: Saha Airlines locates two freighters to Maastricht.

text.p: Saha Airlines, the Iranian airline, has permanently located two Boeing 747 freighter aircraft to Maastricht-Aachen airport, a spokesman for the latter told Reuters.
In a telephone interview, Maastricht's spokesman said Saha had been flying freighters into Maastricht on an ad hoc basis until two weeks ago.
It has now decided to permanently station two aircraft at the southern Dutch airport and the introduction of a third aircraft is being considered, he said.
Dubai will be served on a twice-weekly basis, on Wednesdays and Sundays. Sharjah, also in the United Arab Emirates, will be served on an ad hoc basis.
As well as this, Saha Airlines will also fly to Brazil and Bangladesh, the spokesman said.
Raeford Aviation Services BV in Amsterdam has been named as the general sales agent, the spokesman added.
Aero Cargo International has been appointed the French cargo agent for Saha Airlines for the service between Maastricht and Dubai.
